description: This file defines the CatalogItemViewModelService class, which implements the ICatalogItemViewModelService interface. It manages catalog item view models by updating existing catalog items via a repository, including null checks and updating item details.

classes.name: CatalogItemViewModelService
classes.description: Service class providing methods to manipulate catalog item view models and update corresponding entities in the repository.

methods.name: UpdateCatalogItem
methods.description: Asynchronously updates a catalog item based on data from the view model, with null checks and detail updates.
